package domain

// EventPublisher publishes domain events to NATS or other buses.
type EventPublisher interface {
	Publish(subject string, payload any) error
}

// CommandPublisher dispatches internal work-queue commands. Commands remain on
// plain Core NATS queue semantics and are intentionally separate from durable
// event publishing.
type CommandPublisher interface {
	Publish(subject string, payload any) error
}
